message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on an inflatable kayak/SUP set. Inflatable watercraft fall under heading 8903. Subheading 8903.12 covers inflatable vessels designed solely for use with an outboard motor, but this item is not motorized. Subheading 8903.13 doesn't exist, so the options are 8903.10 (inflatable, other than 8903.11 and 8903.12) and 8903.9x for other vessels.

The current 8903 structure is:
- 8903.11: inflatable sailboats
- 8903.12: inflatable, designed solely for use with an outboard motor
- 8903.19: other inflatable (8903.19.01 and later)
- 8903.91: sailboats
- 8903.92: motorboats
- 8903.99: other (8903.99.05 canoes/kayaks; 8903.99.06 other)

I recall the stat suffixes as 8903.10.0030 for inflatable, and 8903.99.0690 for other. Earlier rulings on inflatable SUPs classified them in 8903.10.0060, "Inflatable vessels... Other". For HTSUS 8903.10.00, the 10-digit breakdown is 8903.10.0030 for canoes and kayaks and 8903.10.0060 for other. Some inflatable SUP rulings used 8903.10.0060 ("Other"), though inflatable kayaks went under 8903.10.0030.

This item is described as both a kayak and a SUP, and the ruling likely classified it under 8903.10.0060 as a general inflatable vessel. I'm not certain, but a hybrid is more likely to be treated as a paddleboard than a pure kayak, so I'll go with 8903.10.0060.

{"hts_code": "8903.10.0060", "reason": "An inflatable kayak/stand-up paddle board is an inflatable watercraft of heading 8903, classified under subheading 8903.10 as an inflatable vessel that is not a pure canoe or kayak."}
